description: A helper class for writing data into a global row buffer using UnsafeArrayData format, used in Spark SQL code generation for unsafe array data handling.

classes.name: UnsafeArrayWriter
classes.description: A final class extending UnsafeWriter, providing methods to initialize and write various data types into an unsafe array buffer, including null handling and variable-length data.

methods.name: assertIndexIsValid
methods.description: Checks if the given index is within valid bounds for the array.

methods.name: UnsafeArrayWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UnsafeArrayWriter with a parent UnsafeWriter and element size.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Prepares the buffer for a specified number of elements, allocating space and setting headers.

methods.name: getElementOffset
methods.description: Calculates the memory offset for a specific element index.

methods.name: setNullBit
methods.description: Sets the null bit for a specific element.

methods.name: setNull1Bytes
methods.description: Sets a null value for a byte-sized element.

methods.name: setNull2Bytes
methods.description: Sets a null value for a short-sized element.

methods.name: setNull4Bytes
methods.description: Sets a null value for an int-sized element.

methods.name: setNull8Bytes
methods.description: Sets a null value for a long-sized element.

methods.name: setNull
methods.description: Sets a null value for an element, defaulting to 8-byte null.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write boolean, byte, short, int, long, float, double, Decimal, and CalendarInterval values into the array at a specified index.
